scoring_justification: Layer bandgap power-law exponent is recomputed from the agent's reported layer bandgaps; piezoelectric constancy is scored by structural audit (standard deviation); other absolute quantities are compared against paper reference values with tolerances.

outputs.description: Monolayer GaInS3 bandgap values, gap type, and band-edge locations computed with PBE and HSE functionals.
HSE bandgap at three uniaxial strains (-4%, 0%, +4%); checks that bandgap decreases under compressive and increases under tensile strain.
HSE bandgaps for monolayer (1), bilayer (2), and trilayer (3) GaInS3.
2D and 3D piezoelectric stress coefficients for 1, 2, and 3 layers; verifies the absence of an odd-even effect and layer-independent e11^3D.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare each artifact against the reference values reported in the paper, using appropriate tolerances for DFT re-runs. For strain_bandgap.csv the trend (gap reduction under compression, increase under tension) is evaluated by threshold_or_better logic.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference values for bandgaps, piezoelectric coefficients, gap type, and locations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper (main text, figures, and supplementary information)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Paper-reported values: monolayer HSE bandgap 3.04 eV, PBE bandgap 2.06 eV, quasi-direct gap 3.07 eV, CBM at Gamma, VBM along Gamma-X, e11_3D ~0.23 C/m^2, e12_3D ~0.04 C/m^2, power-law exponent ~0.94.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are explicitly stated or derived from the paper’s results and used solely as hidden comparators; the checker does not fabricate a new hidden ground truth but validates against the published outcomes.
